newsitem.title: HUNGARY: New Quaestor shares to appear on Budapest bourse.
newsitem.headline: New Quaestor shares to appear on Budapest bourse.

text.p: Quaestor Securities and Investment Rt will in December publicly offer new shares which are to be introduced onto the Budapest Stock Exchange, Hungarian news agency MTI reported on Tuesday.
Quaestor will be the first securities trader to go public since the BSE was re-established in 1990.
The shares, with a nominal value of between 100 million and 500 million forints will be on sale from December 3 to 22.

Quaestor will issue between 100,000 and 500,000 registered "A" series ordinary shares and a single "B" series preference voting share to be held by Quaestor Financial Consultancy Rt, which is currently the company's sole shareholder.
Each share has a nominal value of 1,000 forints. "A" series shares will be offered at 2,500 forints and the "B" series share will be issued at par.
Quaestor Securities and Investment Rt was established in September through the conversion of a limited company wholly owned by Quaestor Financial Consultancy Rt.
